Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up on the benchmark report — would love a demo

Hi — I just finished the Signalytics section of the Redwood benchmark report (very helpful — thanks). We're exploring options to improve inference cost and latency on our ML features and I'd like a short demo of your Dedicated options and any tips on batching/kv cache that would apply to our workload.

We are based in PDT. Available windows this week: Mon/Wed afternoons or Thu morning. Happy to work with whatever slot you have.

Attached my notes from the report.

Best,
Jordan Ellis
Senior ML Engineer
Signalytics

Attachments: signalytics_notes.txt (text)

Hi Jordan — thanks for downloading the benchmark and for the note. I'm Priyom on the SDR team — I handle intake for demos coming from content downloads.

Quick Qs before we lock time:
- Are you evaluating a proof-of-concept (production pilot) or just an exploratory review?
- Any team members (ops/infra/CTO) you'd want on the call?

I can put you with Karthik (AE) for a 30-min walkthrough focused on Dedicated + batching patterns. Tentative options in PDT: Mon 4/5 2:00–2:30pm, Wed 4/7 3:00–3:30pm, Thu 4/8 9:30–10:00am. If those don't work, share a preferred time and I will coordinate.

I attached a one-page summary of what customers typically ask after the benchmark (latency SLOs, batch sizes, KV cache tips).

Best,
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference
